page.description: Configure docstube.yml, ia.yml, glossary.yaml, agents, locales, components, and plugins.
page.title: Configuration

findings.message: The budget summary overstates `maxRunUsd` as the effective run cap.
findings.rationale: The paragraph says "`maxRunUsd` is the run cap," but the preceding checked/marked budget behavior says `createRunCostTracker` freezes a run at 85 percent of `maxRunUsd` when there is no plan-usage signal. A maintainer could read the summary as meaning the configured dollar value is the usable cap in all cases.

findings.message: The comment-preservation conclusion is broader than the evidence stated on the page.
findings.rationale: The paragraph says a maintainer can keep hand-written comments "in the config family" while using the UI or wizard, but the marked evidence only says `writeIaFile` preserves a top-of-file comment and that YAML is parsed/serialized with `parseDocument` and `doc.toString`. That does not establish preservation of arbitrary comments across `docstube.yml`, `ia.yml`, and `glossary.yaml`.

findings.message: The plugins section needs a trust warning for configured plugin specifiers.
findings.rationale: The page says `loadConfiguredPlugins` loads each configured plugin specifier, treats relative specifiers as local plugins, resolves package specifiers from the target repository, and requires a default export created with `definePlugin`. A maintainer acting on this section could add a local or package plugin without being warned that plugin code should be trusted before loading.
